question: How is the manifest range characterized and what topic is introduced next?
premises: All that manifest range is declared to be produced.
It is subject to arising and destruction.
Now the measure of all the worlds, as taught by the gurus, will be presented.
inference: The produced cosmos is impermanent, and the text now turns to the gurus' account of the worlds' measure.
plain_english: All that is declared to be produced and subject to arising and destruction. Now I will present the measure of all the worlds as it was taught to me by my own gurus.
